sections.heading: Section 1: Radian Measure, Arc Length and Sectors

questions.q: A circle of radius $8 \text{ cm}$ has a central sector with angle $\theta = \frac{3\pi}{4} \text{ rad}$. Find the exact arc length of the sector.
Find the area of a sector of radius $6 \text{ cm}$ having perimeter $22 \text{ cm}$.
questions.answer: Perimeter $= 2r + s = 12 + s = 22 \Rightarrow s = 10 \text{ cm}$. Area $= \frac{1}{2}rs = \frac{1}{2}(6)(10) = 30 \text{ cm}^2$.

questions.q: A chord of length $10 \text{ cm}$ subtends an angle of $2\theta$ at the center of a circle of radius $13 \text{ cm}$. Find $\sin\theta$.
questions.answer: The chord is bisected: half-chord $= 5 \text{ cm}$. In the right triangle, $\sin\theta = \frac{5}{13}$.

questions.q: Given that $\tan\theta = -\frac{3}{4}$ and $\theta$ lies in the second quadrant, find the value of $\cos\theta$.
questions.answer: In quadrant 2, cosine is negative. With opposite 3 and adjacent 4, hypotenuse is 5: $\cos\theta = -4/5$.

questions.q: Prove the identity $\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = 1$. Which of the following equals $(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)$?
Find all solutions of $3\sin x = 2\cos^2 x$ in the interval $0^\circ \leq x \leq 360^\circ$.
questions.answer: $3\sin x = 2(1 - \sin^2 x) \Rightarrow 2\sin^2 x + 3\sin x - 2 = 0 \Rightarrow (2\sin x - 1)(\sin x + 2) = 0 \Rightarrow \sin x = 1/2 \Rightarrow x = 30^\circ, 150^\circ$.
